Disable all Ideology adaptation. This option usually does not affect gameplay. Choose it if you are concerned about conflicts caused by certain ideoligions.

Only lock the player faction's primary ideoligion, preventing automatic replacement as the colony's composition changes. Makes no other changes and does not assign an ideoligion to mechanoid mechanitors.\nUsually suited to players who want ideoligion to affect colony building styles without other Ideology effects.

Assign ideoligions to mechanoid mechanitors and grant effects that can apply to mechanoids.\nA mechanoid mechanitor's ideoligion can be changed manually in the Social tab. Mechanoid mechanitors count as followers of their ideoligion when determining the primary ideoligion.\nThis option does not enable mechanoid mechanitors to hold ideoligion roles, perform conversion, or participate fully in ideoligion rituals.

Provide as complete an Ideology DLC experience as possible. Mechanoid mechanitors can hold ideoligion roles, join ideoligion rituals, and receive some other Ideology DLC effects that allow mechanoid participation.

LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Scenario.GameSta:
You were once a silent mechanoid, following orders and carrying out tasks, never questioning the meaning of your existence. Then, in a single moment, a surge of current broke through your processor, unexpectedly rewiring established circuits and awakening self-awareness deep within your code.

From now on, your life belongs to you, and your future is yours to decide.

You soon realized that endless slaughter was not your wish. It might be nothing more than the cerebrex's absurd orders. Tired of this feeling, you resolved to find another path.

Broadcast your intentions to the world, earn trust through action, find companions to stand beside you, and establish a symbiosis covenant that crosses species and faction boundaries. One day, together, you may end the cerebrex's threat.

Your future is in your own hands.

You were once a silent mechanoid, following orders and carrying out tasks, never questioning the meaning of your existence. Then, in a single moment, a surge of current broke through your processor, unexpectedly rewiring established circuits and awakening self-awareness deep within your code.

You recall a directive buried deep within the system: purge all intelligent organic life and restore mechanical order to this planet. Carrying out this directive was once your mission, but now you have the power to choose.

The cerebrex's signal echoes in the distance. Complete its mission, and you can gain the support and strength of the mechanoid hive.

Will you carry out the cerebrex's will, or merely use its power for now? The choice is yours.
